verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents Slack and PagerDuty integrations for error alerts, Insights alarms that fire when a BadgerQL query result crosses a configured threshold, and anomaly detection that flags unusual spikes in error volume. Together these cover the destinations and frequency-spike alerting, but not the per-dimension routing rules the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented routing rules by environment and severity, an affected-user-count threshold, an explicit new-issue trigger rule, email as a destination, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
